description: Add CMS webhook content type and admin UI. Includes Strapi content type schema, AdminClient webhook methods, and basic list/edit UI components.
steps: 1. Create cms/src/api/webhook/content-types/webhook/schema.json following connection schema pattern: collectionType with fields webhookId (uid, required), name (string, required), secretRef (string, maxLength 256), provider (enumeration: stripe|github|generic, default generic), flowId (relation to flow), mapping (json), filter (json), environment (relation to environment), engineVersion (integer), lastSyncStatus (enumeration: none|synced|failed).
2. Create cms/src/api/webhook/controllers/webhook.ts, routes/webhook.ts, services/webhook.ts following existing API patterns (can be minimal - Strapi generates CRUD).
3. Create cms/src/components/webhook/mapping-field.json component for the mapping field structure (array of {sourceJsonPath: string, targetContextPath: string}).
4. Create cms/src/components/webhook/filter-field.json component for filter structure (array of {jsonPath: string, allowedValues: string[]}).

5. Add webhook types to cms/types/engine.ts: WebhookConfig interface (id, name, secretRef, provider, flowId, mapping, filter), CreateWebhookRequest, CreateWebhookResponse, ListWebhooksResponse, GetWebhookResponse, UpdateWebhookRequest, WebhookLogEntry, WebhookLogsResponse.

6. Extend AdminClient in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/admin-client.ts with webhook methods: listWebhooks(), getWebhook(id), createWebhook(req), updateWebhook(id, req), deleteWebhook(id), getWebhookLogs(id, opts).

7. Create basic webhook management page cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/pages/WebhooksPage.tsx: list webhooks with name, provider, flowId, status. Use @strapi/design-system components (Table, Button, Box). Link to standard Strapi content manager for editing (no custom editor needed initially).
8. Register WebhooksPage in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/index.tsx if plugin uses custom pages, otherwise rely on content manager auto-generation.
9. Add tests in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/webhook-admin.test.ts: test AdminClient webhook methods mock responses.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook content type schema created with all required fields (webhookId, name, secretRef, provider, flowId, mapping, filter)
Provider field is enumeration with stripe, github, generic options
secretRef is stored as reference string, never actual secret value
AdminClient has typed methods for all webhook CRUD operations
Webhooks appear in Strapi content manager
npm run build succeeds in cms directory
npm run test passes in cms directory
